mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly describes the timeline of the Prime Minister Internship Scheme?
options: Its pilot began in October 2024, and it was announced in Budget 2024–25.
Its pilot began in Budget 2024–25, and it was announced in October 2024.
Its pilot began in October 2024, and it was announced in Budget 2024–25 as a completed programme.
Its pilot began in Budget 2024–25, and it was announced in October 2024 as a completed programme.
mcqs.explanation: The pilot of the Prime Minister Internship Scheme began in October 2024, while the scheme was announced in Budget 2024–25. The tempting alternatives reverse these details or incorrectly describe the pilot as a completed programme in the budget announcement.
